Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really excited by the latency/cost story. Catalyst is ready to move from discovery to an enablement plan for our SI team. To get started we need:
- A lightweight implementation checklist our consultants can follow (1-2 pages)
- A proposal for a two-week enablement sprint (materials, lab access, trainer hours)
- A sample Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can present to procurement

Can you put together those artifacts and a proposed timeline? Goal is to kickoff training the week of Nov 16.

Best,
Nora Patel
Director, Partnerships | Catalyst Consulting

Hi Nora — great to hear. Attaching a quick first pass: a one-page QuickStart checklist, a draft MAP, and a proposed enablement sprint outline. High-level plan below: 

1) Pre-kickoff (Nov 9-13): transfer access (labs + test tenant), review Catalyst sample workloads
2) Week 1 (Nov 16-20): hands-on lab sessions (dev + infra tracks), Redwood runtime tuning workshop
3) Week 2 (Nov 23-27): advanced troubleshooting, joint runbook, customer-facing enablement assets

Please review the attached and tell us which trainer cadence you prefer (3x 90m vs 5x 60m).

Attachments: Catalyst_QuickStart_Steps.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, SOW-draft-Catalyst-v1.docx

Thanks,
Ava Chen

Ava / Jordan — quick internal notes after reviewing Ava's attachments:

- QuickStart PDF: add a short troubleshooting section for common model mismatch errors (model variant vs quantization profile). I can draft a paragraph.
- MAP: procurement will ask for milestone-based acceptance criteria. Suggest adding a UAT gate after Week 2 with a sample acceptance test that Catalyst can run.
- SOW: legal will want specific SLAs called out (latency P95 and uptime for dedicated pools). I'll flag with Contracts.

Operational asks (need by Nov 6 to keep Nov 16 kickoff):
- Jordan: please provision the Catalyst dev tenant and service account (minimal perms) — ticket in Jira SUP-1291.
- Marissa: can you confirm trainer availability for Nov 16-27 (2 trainers, 20 hours total)?

I'll take the troubleshooting paragraph and the UAT gate text.

—Camila
Partner Enablement Manager
